description.content: Returns a list of `contribution reports`. The reports are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recent reports appearing first.

query.description: Unique identifier of the employer for filtering reports
Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `open`, `finalized`.
Month for filtering reports, used together with `year` (MM format)
Year for filtering reports, can be used standalone or with `month` (YYYY format)
Unique identifier of the customer for EoR platforms, used to filter reports for a logical employer
The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.
The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

response.name: OK

description.content: This endpoint finalizes the `contribution report` object, making it immutable and preventing any further updates. Once finalized, its `status` changes to `finalized`, and it serves as a historical record for payroll reporting. Any changes or adjustments that occur after the finalization will roll into the next reporting period.
Returns the `employee breakdown` for a `contribution report`.
